mapper.select: SELECT EMP_ID AS empId, PROVIDER_CD AS providerCd, EMAIL_ADDR AS emailAddr, GOOGLE_SUB_ID AS googleSubId, ACCESS_TOKEN AS accessToken, REFRESH_TOKEN AS refreshToken, TOKEN_EXPR_DT AS tokenExprDt, SCOPE_CN AS scopeCn, GOOGLE_HISTORY_ID AS googleHistoryId, SYNC_LAST_DT AS syncLastDt, WATCH_EXPR_DT AS watchExprDt, TOKEN_STATUS_CD AS tokenStatusCd, USE_YN AS useYn, CONNECTED_DT AS connectedDt, REVOKED_DT AS revokedDt, FRST_REG_DT AS frstRegDt, LAST_MDFCN_DT AS lastMdfcnDt FROM TB_MAIL_ACCOUNT WHERE EMP_ID = #{empId} AND PROVIDER_CD = 'GOOGLE' AND USE_YN = 'Y' AND TOKEN_STATUS_CD = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_MAIL_MESSAGE ( MAIL_MSG_ID, EMP_ID, EXTERNAL_MSG_ID, EXTERNAL_THREAD_ID, MESSAGE_ID_HEADER, MAIL_SJ, MAIL_CN, SNIPPET, FROM_EMAIL, TO_SUMMARY, MAIL_SNDNG_DT, INTERNAL_DATE, DRAFT_YN, BODY_SYNC_YN, DEL_YN, FRST_REG_DT ) VALUES ( #{mailId}, #{empId}, #{externalMessageId}, #{threadId}, #{messageIdHeader}, #{subject}, #{content}, #{snippet}, #{fromEmail}, #{toSummary}, #{sentAt}, #{internalDate}, #{draftYn}, #{bodySyncYn}, #{delYn}, SYSDATE )
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_MAIL_MESSAGE SET MAIL_CN = #{content}, SNIPPET = COALESCE(#{snippet}, SNIPPET), BODY_SYNC_YN = 'Y', LAST_MDFCN_DT = SYSDATE WHERE EMP_ID = #{empId} AND MAIL_MSG_ID = #{mailId} AND DEL_YN = 'N'
mapper.select: SELECT MAIL_MSG_ID AS MAIL_ID, EMP_ID, EXTERNAL_MSG_ID AS EXTERNAL_MESSAGE_ID, EXTERNAL_THREAD_ID AS THREAD_ID, MESSAGE_ID_HEADER, MAIL_SJ AS SUBJECT, MAIL_CN AS CONTENT, SNIPPET, FROM_EMAIL, TO_SUMMARY, MAIL_SNDNG_DT AS SENT_AT, INTERNAL_DATE, DRAFT_YN, BODY_SYNC_YN, DEL_YN FROM TB_MAIL_MESSAGE WHERE EMP_ID = #{empId} AND MAIL_MSG_ID = #{mailId} AND DEL_YN = 'N'
mapper.sql: CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_MAIL_LABEL_MAP LM JOIN TB_MAIL_LABEL L ON L.MAIL_LABEL_ID = LM.MAIL_LABEL_ID WHERE LM.EMP_ID = M.EMP_ID AND LM.MAIL_MSG_ID = M.MAIL_MSG_ID AND TRIM(L.LABEL_TYPE_CD) = 'UNREAD' ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS UNREAD, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_MAIL_LABEL_MAP LM JOIN TB_MAIL_LABEL L ON L.MAIL_LABEL_ID = LM.MAIL_LABEL_ID WHERE LM.EMP_ID = M.EMP_ID AND LM.MAIL_MSG_ID = M.MAIL_MSG_ID AND TRIM(L.LABEL_TYPE_CD) = 'IMPORTANT' ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS IMPORTANT

NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_MAIL_LABEL_MAP NTL JOIN TB_MAIL_LABEL NTLB ON NTLB.MAIL_LABEL_ID = NTL.MAIL_LABEL_ID WHERE NTL.EMP_ID = M.EMP_ID AND NTL.MAIL_MSG_ID = M.MAIL_MSG_ID AND TRIM(NTLB.LABEL_TYPE_CD) = 'TRASH' )
mapper.select:
SELECT M.MAIL_MSG_ID AS MAIL_ID, M.EXTERNAL_MSG_ID AS EXTERNAL_MESSAGE_ID, M.EXTERNAL_THREAD_ID AS THREAD_ID, M.MAIL_SJ AS SUBJECT, M.SNIPPET, M.FROM_EMAIL, M.TO_SUMMARY, M.MAIL_SNDNG_DT AS SENT_AT, , CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_MAIL_ATTACHMENT A WHERE A.EMP_ID = M.EMP_ID AND A.MAIL_MSG_ID = M.MAIL_MSG_ID ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS HAS_ATTACHMENT FROM TB_MAIL_MESSAGE M WHERE M.EMP_ID = #{empId} AND M.DEL_YN = 'N'
AND AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_MAIL_LABEL_MAP LM JOIN TB_MAIL_LABEL L ON L.MAIL_LABEL_ID = LM.MAIL_LABEL_ID WHERE LM.EMP_ID = M.EMP_ID AND LM.MAIL_MSG_ID = M.MAIL_MSG_ID AND TRIM(L.LABEL_TYPE_CD) = 'INBOX' )
AND AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_MAIL_LABEL_MAP LM JOIN TB_MAIL_LABEL L ON L.MAIL_LABEL_ID = LM.MAIL_LABEL_ID WHERE LM.EMP_ID = M.EMP_ID AND LM.MAIL_MSG_ID = M.MAIL_MSG_ID AND TRIM(L.LABEL_TYPE_CD) = 'SENT' )
AND AND LOWER(M.FROM_EMAIL) = LOWER(#{emailAddr}) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_MAIL_PARTICIPANT P WHERE P.EMP_ID = M.EMP_ID AND P.MAIL_MSG_ID = M.MAIL_MSG_ID AND TRIM(P.PARTICIPANT_TYPE_CD) = 'TO' AND LOWER(P.EMAIL_ADDR) = LOWER(#{emailAddr}) )
AND AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_MAIL_PARTICIPANT P WHERE P.EMP_ID = M.EMP_ID AND P.MAIL_MSG_ID = M.MAIL_MSG_ID AND TRIM(P.PARTICIPANT_TYPE_CD) IN ('TO', 'CC') AND LOWER(P.EMAIL_ADDR) = LOWER(#{emailAddr}) )
AND
AND ( LOWER(M.MAIL_SJ) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR LOWER(M.SNIPPET) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR LOWER(M.FROM_EMAIL) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR LOWER(M.TO_SUMMARY) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' )
ORDER BY M.MAIL_SNDNG_DT DESC NULLS LAST, M.MAIL_MSG_ID DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY

SELECT M.MAIL_MSG_ID AS MAIL_ID, M.EXTERNAL_MSG_ID AS EXTERNAL_MESSAGE_ID, M.EXTERNAL_THREAD_ID AS THREAD_ID, M.MAIL_SJ AS SUBJECT, M.SNIPPET, M.FROM_EMAIL, M.TO_SUMMARY, M.MAIL_SNDNG_DT AS SENT_AT, , CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_MAIL_ATTACHMENT A WHERE A.EMP_ID = M.EMP_ID AND A.MAIL_MSG_ID = M.MAIL_MSG_ID ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS HAS_ATTACHMENT FROM TB_MAIL_MESSAGE M WHERE M.EMP_ID = #{empId} AND M.DEL_YN = 'N' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_MAIL_LABEL_MAP LM JOIN TB_MAIL_LABEL L ON L.MAIL_LABEL_ID = LM.MAIL_LABEL_ID WHERE LM.EMP_ID = M.EMP_ID AND LM.MAIL_MSG_ID = M.MAIL_MSG_ID AND TRIM(L.LABEL_TYPE_CD) = 'TRASH' ) ORDER BY M.MAIL_SNDNG_DT DESC NULLS LAST, M.MAIL_MSG_ID DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY

SELECT M.MAIL_MSG_ID AS MAIL_ID, M.EXTERNAL_MSG_ID AS EXTERNAL_MESSAGE_ID, M.EXTERNAL_THREAD_ID AS THREAD_ID, M.MAIL_SJ AS SUBJECT, M.MAIL_CN AS CONTENT, M.SNIPPET, M.FROM_EMAIL, M.MAIL_SNDNG_DT AS SENT_AT,
FROM TB_MAIL_MESSAGE M WHERE M.EMP_ID = #{empId} AND M.MAIL_MSG_ID = #{mailId} AND M.DEL_YN = 'N'
SELECT TRIM(PARTICIPANT_TYPE_CD) AS type, EMAIL_ADDR AS email FROM TB_MAIL_PARTICIPANT WHERE EMP_ID = #{empId} AND MAIL_MSG_ID = #{mailId} ORDER BY MAIL_PARTICIPANT_ID

SELECT A.MAIL_ATCH_FILE_ID AS attachmentId, D.ORGNL_FILE_NM AS originalFileName, D.FILE_SZ AS fileSize, D.ATCH_FILE_TY_CD AS contentType FROM TB_MAIL_ATTACHMENT A LEFT JOIN TB_CMMN_ATCH_FILE_DTL D ON D.ATCH_FILE_DTL_ID = A.MAIL_ATCH_FILE_ID WHERE A.EMP_ID = #{empId} AND A.MAIL_MSG_ID = #{mailId} ORDER BY A.MAIL_ATCH_FILE_ID

SELECT M.MAIL_MSG_ID AS MAIL_ID, M.EMP_ID, M.EXTERNAL_MSG_ID AS EXTERNAL_MESSAGE_ID, M.EXTERNAL_THREAD_ID AS THREAD_ID, M.MESSAGE_ID_HEADER, M.MAIL_SJ AS SUBJECT, M.MAIL_CN AS CONTENT, M.SNIPPET, M.FROM_EMAIL, M.TO_SUMMARY, M.MAIL_SNDNG_DT AS SENT_AT, M.INTERNAL_DATE, M.DRAFT_YN, M.BODY_SYNC_YN, M.DEL_YN FROM TB_MAIL_MESSAGE M WHERE M.EMP_ID = #{empId} AND M.DEL_YN = 'N' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_MAIL_LABEL_MAP LM JOIN TB_MAIL_LABEL L ON L.MAIL_LABEL_ID = LM.MAIL_LABEL_ID WHERE LM.EMP_ID = M.EMP_ID AND LM.MAIL_MSG_ID = M.MAIL_MSG_ID AND TRIM(L.LABEL_TYPE_CD) = 'TRASH' )
mapper.insert: MERGE INTO TB_MAIL_LABEL target USING ( SELECT #{labelId} AS MAIL_LABEL_ID, #{empId} AS EMP_ID, #{externalLabelId} AS EXTERNAL_LABEL_ID, #{labelName} AS LABEL_NM, #{labelTypeCd} AS LABEL_TYPE_CD FROM DUAL ) source ON ( target.EMP_ID = source.EMP_ID AND TRIM(target.LABEL_TYPE_CD) = source.LABEL_TYPE_CD ) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET target.EXTERNAL_LABEL_ID = source.EXTERNAL_LABEL_ID, target.LABEL_NM = source.LABEL_NM, target.SYSTEM_YN = 'Y', target.USE_YN = 'Y' WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( MAIL_LABEL_ID, EMP_ID, EXTERNAL_LABEL_ID, LABEL_NM, SYSTEM_YN, LABEL_TYPE_CD, USE_YN ) VALUES ( source.MAIL_LABEL_ID, source.EMP_ID, source.EXTERNAL_LABEL_ID, source.LABEL_NM, 'Y', source.LABEL_TYPE_CD, 'Y' )
INSERT INTO TB_MAIL_LABEL_MAP ( MAIL_LABEL_MAP_ID, MAIL_MSG_ID, EMP_ID, MAIL_LABEL_ID ) VALUES ( #{labelMapId}, #{mailId}, #{empId}, #{labelId} )
INSERT INTO TB_MAIL_PARTICIPANT ( MAIL_PARTICIPANT_ID, MAIL_MSG_ID, EMP_ID, EMAIL_ADDR, PARTICIPANT_TYPE_CD ) VALUES ( #{participantId}, #{mailId}, #{empId}, #{email}, #{type} )
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_MAIL_ACCOUNT SET ACCESS_TOKEN = #{accessToken}, TOKEN_EXPR_DT = #{tokenExprDt}, TOKEN_STATUS_CD = #{tokenStatusCd}, LAST_MDFCN_DT = SYSDATE WHERE EMP_ID = #{empId} AND PROVIDER_CD = 'GOOGLE'
